title: Monkey eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Monkey head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="28" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- Face patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="20" ry="17" fill="#F5C99B"/>
  <!-- Ear left -->
  <circle cx="21" cy="36" r="9" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <circle cx="21" cy="36" r="5" fill="#F5C99B"/>
  <!-- Ear right -->
  <circle cx="79" cy="36" r="9" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <circle cx="79" cy="36" r="5" fill="#F5C99B"/>
  <!-- Eye left -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="40" r="5" fill="#2E1A0E"/>
  <circle cx="41.5" cy="38.5" r="1.8" fill="#FFF8E7"/>
  <!-- Eye right -->
  <circle cx="60" cy="40" r="5" fill="#2E1A0E"/>
  <circle cx="61.5" cy="38.5" r="1.8" fill="#FFF8E7"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="49" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#C98B5E"/>
  <!-- Mouth / smile -->
  <path d="M42 54 Q50 61 58 54" fill="none" stroke="#C98B5E" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheek left -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="51" r="4" fill="#F09A8E" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Cheek right -->
  <circle cx="65" cy="51" r="4" fill="#F09A8E" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#F5C99B"/>
  <!-- Left arm holding snack -->
  <path d="M34 72 Q26 62 34 56" fill="none" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right arm holding snack -->
  <path d="M66 72 Q74 62 66 56" fill="none" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Banana snack -->
  <path d="M34 54 Q48 44 62 52 Q56 58 42 58 Z" fill="#F7E05A"/>
  <path d="M34 54 Q30 50 34 46" fill="#F7E05A" stroke="#E8C93A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M38 55 Q48 48 58 53" fill="none" stroke="#E8C93A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- Hand left over banana -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="56" r="5" fill="#F5C99B"/>
  <!-- Hand right over banana -->
  <circle cx="63" cy="55" r="5" fill="#F5C99B"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M68 88 Q84 92 80 76 Q78 68 86 64" fill="none" stroke="#8B5E3C" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
